tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search and rank MCP servers by capability, auth preference, client target, and risk tolerance.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked candidates to return.

query.description: Optional free-text query to bias ranking toward a specific use case or domain.

capabilities.description: Normalized capability taxonomy terms such as healthcare, search, read, exec, files, oauth, or prompts.

client_target.description: Optional target client or integration surface.

risk_tolerance.description: How much tool-surface risk is acceptable.

auth_preference.description: Preferred auth mode. Use unauthenticated when the agent must avoid login flows.

tools.name: recommend_servers
tools.description: Recommend MCP servers for a plain-language task and return ranked matches with install config.

task.description: Plain-language task description such as 'I need an MCP for healthcare denial scoring in OpenAI connectors'.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return.

capabilities.description: Optional explicit capability constraints that override or extend the inferred task capabilities.

client_target.description: Optional target client or integration surface.

risk_tolerance.description: How much tool-surface risk is acceptable.

tools.name: get_server_report
tools.description: Return the full machine-readable verify report for a specific MCP server identifier.

identifier.description: Canonical server identifier in namespace/name format.

tools.name: compare_servers
tools.description: Compare up to four MCP servers side by side across score, verdict, auth, tool count, prompts/resources, and freshness.

identifiers.description: Canonical server identifiers in namespace/name format.
